show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Ana Marshall – The Climb to Investment Excellence (EP.360)
summary:
This time
around, we discuss Ana’s recently published book, The Climb to
Investment Excellence. It is an outstanding, thorough guide for any
leader overseeing a pool of institutional capital. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more.
